drhp.business: Hexagon Nutrition is a fully integrated nutrition company (R&D to manufacturing to marketing) operating across three segments: branded wellness/clinical nutrition (B2C; brands PENTASURE, OBESIGO, PEDIAGOLD, NUTRONE), customised vitamin/mineral premix formulations for Indian and multinational FMCG clients (B2B2C), and Ready-to-Use Foods (RUFs) and Micronutrient Powders (MNPs) supplied to UN agencies and health ministries (ESG). Founded in 1993, it exports to over 75 countries.
drhp.end_markets: Premix formulations B2B2C (FY25 47.61%)|Branded nutrition B2C (FY25 28.34%)|RUFs/MNPs ESG (FY25 23.96%)|Exports (FY25 61.25%, 75+ countries)|Domestic (FY25 38.66%)
drhp.expansion: Operates three Indian facilities (Nasik, Chennai SEZ, Thoothukudi SEZ) and an international facility in Tashkent (Uzbekistan) plus overseas offices in South Africa, Uzbekistan and Hong Kong. Capacity utilisation is low (FY25 30.03%), implying headroom to scale volumes without major near-term capex; the DRHP is a pure Offer for Sale with no fresh-issue-funded expansion.

India remains a large undernutrition market (contributing ~30% of global childhood stunting) supported by government schemes such as POSHAN Abhiyaan and ICDS.
